findings.mechanism: Hard‑coded database credentials expose a secret in source code, violating secret‑management best practices (no reference number but aligns with general secret‑exposure guidance).
findings.remediation: Remove the default URL containing credentials; require DATABASE_URL to be provided via environment and raise an error if missing, ensuring no credentials are stored in source.
findings.arithmetic: The credential string "postgresql+asyncpg://app:app@db:5432/app" is present verbatim in the source at line 9, exposing the username and password unconditionally.
